استذممت (form X)
# اِسْتَذْمَمْتُ (istaḏmamtu) /is.tað.mam.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَذَمَّ (istaḏamma)
# اِسْتَذْمَمْتَ (istaḏmamta) /is.tað.mam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَذَمَّ (istaḏamma)
# اِسْتَذْمَمْتِ (istaḏmamti) /is.tað.mam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَذَمَّ (istaḏamma)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
